udyāpana
(‘concluding’)
------------------------------------------
Any religious vrata or rite has to be concluded with the rite prescribed for it generally called उद्यापन or pāraṇā.
It consists in taking ड़ोओद् after the ड़स्तिन्ग् involved in the vrata, and giving gifts to the needy.

Udyogaparva
------------------------------------------
It is the fifth book of the great epic Mahābhārata. See the same for details.
